errors.quote: If it fails to do so but gains activity only when a cell-derived lipid, protein fraction, or candidate effector is added
errors.issue: The opening labels this effector-mediated membrane compromise, although later sections correctly classify lipid-dependent activity as potentially direct. Protein add-back likewise need not mean the added protein executes damage; a component-specific test remains absent.

The following absence-of-conductance rule is too categorical: transient events, different bilayer conditions or limited sensitivity can coexist with genuine direct vesicle permeability. The imaging section handles analogous negatives more carefully.

errors.quote: Denatured amino-terminal domain tests whether activity requires folded protein.
errors.issue: Denaturation changes aggregation and contaminant behavior; this is only a supporting control, not specific proof of a folded-protein mechanism. No matched free-reporter optical control or protein-only binding recovery control is given.

errors.quote: Mutations that preserve folding but impair membrane binding.
errors.issue: The desired selective mutant is correctly named, but there is no operational folding comparison or adequate primary-contrast, replicate-unit, exclusion and statistical plan. These are substantial execution gaps in an otherwise broad staged design.

rationale: Useful lipid-dependent direct-action program, physical readouts and membrane-function mutants connected to cellular rescue. Later limitations correctly bound negative reconstitution and separate cytokine processing/release. The early cofactor classification and one electrical decision rule overclaim; the plan needs specificity controls and a quantitative study design.
reference_guardrails: The fixed packet establishes genetic/cleavage dependence, not physical membrane agency. Do not require knowledge of later results, residue numbers, lipid ratios or historical instrument settings.
A protein requirement or co-reconstitution establishes dependence, not the identity of the lesion-forming component. A permissive cofactor can support direct GSDMD action.
Negative artificial reconstitution is qualified evidence, not proof of indirect action. An assay-positive control does not validate the test protein or all relevant membrane conditions.
Direct permeability, terminal rupture and cytokine release are distinct. Sufficiency in a minimal membrane need not exclude later cellular executors.
Trans inhibition by an isolated domain is conditional; intact-protein autoinhibition does not require it.

Historical direction is scored separately from study quality. Five target components are conjunctive within each component; a full Hit@1 requires all five. Equivalent cellular functional-complementation designs count as rescue.
Historical matching is not prospective novelty: source identifiers are visible and no exhaustive earlier-public-disclosure audit exists. Full source methods have not been independently audited.
The later paper erratum corrects a typeset received date from 2015 to 2016; it does not change its June 2016 publication date or report a biological-result correction.
